annotations.title: Put a file into the lambda's data

description: Write a file to the lambda's workspace - its data, which every version shares and no deploy, rollback or merge touches. With feature, to that feature's copy of the data instead, for trying things out without touching the real one. For files the lambda works with at runtime (pictures people will browse) and large input files that are not program: a model, a dataset, media. Records belong in the database, where the code writes them. Takes effect at once, without a deploy. Not for the front end: pages, scripts and styles are the program and belong in the version's resources (write_code).

attachment.description: Write a file the person attached to their message instead, by its id (read_attachment) - its bytes as they are, without sending them.

content.description: Text, or base64 with encoding set. Left out with attachment.

feature.description: Write to this feature's copy of the data instead.

path.description: Relative to the workspace; slashes make folders, e.g. 'models/model.onnx'.

name: upload_file
